verdict.rationale: Warp explicitly documents typing '#' plus natural language to get AI Command Suggestions generated in place in the command line (warp-docs-8, warp-docs-54), with real-time suggestion loading and even contextual suggestions inside interactive CLI tools. This is corroborated by multiple docs pages describing the same 'Generate' feature. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community confirmation specifically of this in-place suggestion feature (community evidence focuses on other AI/terminal issues, not this specific flow).
